# Welcome

This handbook covers **policies** and [benefits](https://example.com/benefits) for all staff.
It is updated quarterly.

## Time off

Everyone gets 25 days of paid leave per year. Unused days carry over.

- Request leave in the HR portal
- Manager approval is required
  - Except for sick leave, which is self-certified
- Public holidays are extra

### Parental leave

1. Notify your manager
2. Submit the form

## Expenses

| Category | Limit | Receipt required |
|---|---|---|
| Meals | $50/day | yes |
| Hotel | $200/night | yes |
| Taxi | $30 | no |

Reimbursement takes `5` business days.

```python
def reimburse(amount: float) -> bool:
    return amount <= LIMIT
```
